import os
os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = "1"

import json
from awq import AutoAWQForCausalLM
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

model_path = "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/llama_lora_scierc_merged/"
quant_path = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama-8B-SciERC-FT-AWQ-INT4/"

print(f"Loading model from {model_path}")
model = AutoAWQForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model_path)
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path, trust_remote_code=True)

quant_config = {"zero_point": True, "q_group_size": 128, "w_bit": 4, "version": "GEMM"}

# Build calibration data from SciERC test set
calib_data = []
data_file = "/root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/data/processed_data/test.json"
with open(data_file) as f:
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        doc = json.loads(line)
        for sent_tokens in doc.get("sentences", []):
            text = " ".join(sent_tokens)
            if len(text) > 20:
                calib_data.append(text)
            if len(calib_data) >= 128:
                break
        if len(calib_data) >= 128:
            break

print(f"Calibration samples: {len(calib_data)}")
print(f"Sample: {calib_data[0][:100]}...")

print("Quantizing...")
model.quantize(tokenizer, quant_config=quant_config, calib_data=calib_data)

os.makedirs(quant_path, exist_ok=True)
model.save_quantized(quant_path)
tokenizer.save_pretrained(quant_path)
print(f"Quantization complete! Saved to {quant_path}")
PYEOF
